On Mon, May 5, 2008 at 9:15 AM, Lemmings <snooz...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> what if my cesN is a list containing two components each representing
> different chips? getCdf doesn't seem to work in this case. Does that
> mean you have to extract raw CNs for each chip separately?

Yes, you have to do those calculations for each chip type separately
and then merge the data yourself.

Note that I have now added the following paragraph to Vignette
'Calculating raw total copy numbers manually':

"Note, a more convenient way to extract raw copy numbers is by using
extractRawCopyNumbers() of CopyNumberChromosomalModel. See Vignettes
'Total copy number analysis (10K, 100K, 500K)' and 'Total Copy Number
Analysis (5.0 & 6.0)' for examples."

which might be what you want.
